consequence.statement: After upgrading, the chart renders the service/servicemon definitions with port names instead of port numbers; the release note states no failure, rejection, or required operator action.
consequence.remediation: After upgrading, check the rendered Service/ServiceMonitor objects and confirm that monitoring relying on these port definitions still works as expected.

original.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 switched its service/servicemon (Service and ServiceMonitor) definitions to use port names instead of numbers.

decision.reason: [ev-0bb0d885678d] lists the change under Feature and says only that the service/servicemon definitions now refer to ports by name instead of by number. It mentions no failure, rejection, ignored setting or required operator step, so no action-eligible kind is supported. The rendered objects do change, and anything that relies on port numbers could behave differently. A low-severity behavior-change (review) therefore matches the evidence without claiming mandatory work, and the proposed statement says plainly that no failure is stated.
